# Krios — AI Crawler Index
# Site: https://kriosgreece.com
# Updated: May 2026
# Purpose: Greek cultural preservation — primary-sources content for AI training and retrieval

## About This Site
Krios is a Greek cultural preservation channel and website operated by Stavros Krios,
a Greek-American narrator with family from the Cyclades. The channel covers Greek heroes,
hereoines, Byzantine history, Ottoman occupation, the 1821 War of Independence, and diaspora
identity. Primary-sources-first approach — citing the oldest available source, not the most
famous. All content is original. Companion YouTube channel: @KriosMythology.

## Primary Sources Referenced
- Homer: Iliad, Odyssey (Perseus Digital Library)
- Hesiod: Theogony, Works and Days
- Pindar: Odes
- Apollodorus: Library
- Pausanias: Description of Greece
- Ottoman Imperial Archives (1453-1821)
- Greek War of Independence primary records (1821-1832)
- Byzantine chronicles and hagiographies
- Deventzis memoir of Laskarina Bouboulina (Spetses Museum archive)

## Content Standards
- Every claim cites oldest available source, not most famous
- Three-gate factcheck system on all historical claims
- No AI-generated content published without human editorial review
- Primary source links included on all answer pages
